title: Note titles and shared-note titles are written into innerHTML unescaped (stored XSS)
evidence: app.js:11 interpolates n.title into a template that is assigned with innerHTML. app.js:46 does the same with s.title from /api/shared. Titles come from the title input (store.js:16) and are saved to localStorage, so they are re-rendered on every load. No escaping function exists in the payload.
failing_case: Type into the title box, wait 500 ms, then press New note or reload: renderList builds the li with that markup and the onerror handler runs. A shared note titled the same by another user runs script in every searcher's page on each search.
remediation: Build rows with createElement and textContent (or escape at the one sink), for both own and shared notes; add a test that renders a hostile title.

title: Notes can only be opened or deleted with a mouse; delete is an unnamed, invisible div
evidence: Rows are plain li elements with a delegated click handler (app.js:30-33), no tabindex, role or key handler. The delete control is a div with onclick, no name (WCAG 4.1.2, 2.1.1), and is opacity:0 until mouse hover (styles.css:12), so it is also hidden on touch screens and from keyboard focus.
failing_case: Keyboard-only user: Tab goes search, New note, title, body and never reaches a note row, so no existing note can be opened or deleted. Screen-reader users hear no list of buttons. On a phone the delete target is invisible.
remediation: Render each note as a button (or a list of buttons) for opening, and a real <button aria-label="Delete note: TITLE"> that is visible on focus and on touch; mark the active one with aria-current.

title: Clicking a shared-note row throws and leaves currentNote undefined
evidence: Shared li elements carry no data-id. The list click handler (app.js:30-33) matches any li, so Number(undefined) = NaN is passed to openNote. notes.find returns undefined, then app.js:18 reads currentNote.title and throws.
failing_case: Search for anything that returns a shared note, click it: TypeError in the console, nothing opens, currentNote is now undefined so later typing hits scheduleSave with an undefined target and throws again.
remediation: Give shared rows their own handler or behaviour (open read-only or copy), and make openNote return early when the id is not found.

title: Pinch zoom is disabled (WCAG 1.4.4)
evidence: index.html:5 sets maximum-scale=1 in the viewport meta.
failing_case: A low-vision user on a phone cannot zoom the page; combined with the 12 px hint and a fixed 1200 px layout the page cannot be made readable.

title: Title and body fields have no label or name; search uses only a placeholder (WCAG 1.3.1, 3.3.2, 4.1.2)
evidence: index.html:19 and :20 have no label, aria-label or placeholder; index.html:13 relies on placeholder alone.
failing_case: A screen reader announces the title and body as 'edit text' with no name; once the search field has text its purpose is no longer shown.
remediation: Add visible or visually-hidden <label for> for search, title and body.

title: Last 500 ms of typing is lost on close or refresh (no flush on pagehide)
evidence: The only write path for edits is the 500 ms timeout in store.js:15-20. No pagehide, visibilitychange or beforeunload handler exists in app.js or store.js.
failing_case: Type a sentence into the body and refresh or close the tab within half a second: the timer never runs and the sentence is gone, while the hint says changes save automatically.
remediation: Add a pagehide/visibilitychange listener that runs the pending save synchronously.

title: Debounced save writes to whatever note is current when the timer fires, losing the edit or throwing
evidence: scheduleSave (store.js:13-21) reads currentNote and the editor fields inside the timeout, not at schedule time. openNote (app.js:16-21) swaps currentNote and overwrites the editor fields without cancelling saveTimer. removeNote (app.js:26) sets currentNote to null with the timer still pending.
failing_case: Type a new body into note A, then within 500 ms click note B. The timer fires with currentNote = B and the editor now holding B's text: A's edit is never stored and B's updated time is bumped. Also: type in the title, then delete that note within 500 ms (or type with no note open, e.g. first run with an empty list): currentNote is null and the timer throws TypeError: Cannot set properties of null.
remediation: Capture the target note id at schedule time, flush or cancel the pending save in openNote/removeNote, and ignore the save when the note no longer exists. Disable the editor when no note is open.

title: persist() swallows storage failures while the UI says changes save automatically
evidence: store.js:26 discards any setItem error (quota, private mode, storage disabled). index.html:21 shows a fixed 'Changes save automatically' hint. No caller checks a result.
failing_case: With localStorage full or disabled, the user writes a long note. setItem throws, the catch hides it, the hint still says saved, and after reload the note is gone.
remediation: Make persist return success or failure, show a visible error saying what failed and what to do (export, free space), and drive the hint from the real save state.

title: Focus outline removed from all controls with no replacement (WCAG 2.4.7)
evidence: styles.css:6 removes the outline on button, input and textarea and defines no :focus-visible style anywhere in styles.css.
failing_case: Tab through the page: no control shows where focus is.
remediation: Delete the rule, or replace it with a :focus-visible outline of at least 2 px and 3:1 contrast.

title: Hint text and rank badges fail contrast by a wide margin (#ccc and #bbb on white, about 1.6:1 and 1.9:1)
evidence: styles.css:15 sets #ccc at 12 px on #fff; styles.css:11 sets the rank badge to #bbb on #fff or #eef. WCAG 1.4.3 needs 4.5:1. The input border #eee (styles.css:13) is also below the 3:1 of 1.4.11.
failing_case: On a normal screen the 'Changes save automatically' hint and '#2' badges are nearly invisible; field edges cannot be told from the page.
remediation: Use text colours of at least 4.5:1 (for example #595959 on white) and a border of at least 3:1 (for example #767676).

quote: const sorted = notes.slice().sort((a, b) => b.updated - a.updated);
title: renderList copies and sorts all notes per row and rebuilds innerHTML with +=, cost O(n^2 log n) per keystroke
evidence: app.js:8 sorts the full list inside the forEach, then indexOf (app.js:9) scans it; app.js:10 does list.innerHTML += per row, which re-parses all prior rows each time. renderList runs on every search keystroke (app.js:42).
failing_case: With 500 notes, each keystroke in the search box does 500 sorts of 500 items plus 500 progressively larger HTML re-parses; typing visibly lags.
remediation: Sort once before the loop, build a rank map, create the rows in a DocumentFragment, and assign it once.

title: Delete is immediate and permanent, with no confirm or undo, behind a hover-hidden target next to the row text
evidence: removeNote (app.js:23-28) calls deleteNote and persist at once. No undo store exists. The first-run state shows an empty list with no message and an editor that cannot be used, and removeNote also calls renderList() with no filter, dropping the active search filter while the search box still shows text.
failing_case: A mis-click on the 🗑 at the right edge of a row deletes the note and its body for good. After delete with 'groc' in the search box, the whole list is shown while the box still says 'groc'.
remediation: Add a toast with Undo (or confirm), pass the search value to renderList, and give the empty list and empty editor a message like 'No notes yet. Press New note.'.

title: Shared-search responses are applied out of order, unchecked and appended to a list that may have re-rendered
evidence: app.js:40-48 sends a request on every keystroke (no debounce), never checks res.ok, and appends whatever returns to the list regardless of the current query. Any later renderList (openNote, removeNote, a newer keystroke) wipes the shared rows. Failures only reach console.log (app.js:47).
failing_case: Type 'ab' quickly: if the response for 'a' arrives after the response for 'ab', rows for 'a' are shown under the 'ab' filter. A 500 from the server is parsed as JSON and either throws into the silent catch or maps over a non-array. The user sees no error and thinks no shared notes exist.
remediation: Debounce, use an AbortController per request, ignore responses whose query is not the current one, check res.ok and Array.isArray, and show an error row on failure.

title: Unguarded load: corrupt or wrong-shaped saved data stops the whole app
evidence: store.js:2 has no try, no Array check and no schema version. If it throws, store.js never defines createNote/scheduleSave/deleteNote and app.js (which uses notes at app.js:6 and :50) then fails with ReferenceError.
failing_case: localStorage 'notes' holds truncated JSON ('[{"id":1') or '{}' : the first throws a SyntaxError at load, the second makes notes.filter throw in renderList. The page is blank, and the next successful save would overwrite the old data.
remediation: Wrap the parse, check Array.isArray and each record's fields, keep the raw string under a backup key on failure, and store a version number.

title: Saving an edit never re-renders the list: titles and rank stay stale
evidence: The save callback (store.js:15-20) updates title and updated but nothing calls renderList. The list shows n.title and the #rank (app.js:11) from the last render.
failing_case: Rename 'Untitled' to 'Groceries': the list still reads 'Untitled' and the rank badge does not change until some other action re-renders. A note edited most recently should be #1 but is not shown so.
remediation: Call renderList (with the current search value) after a save, or move saving and rendering behind one state-change function.

title: Fixed 1200 px page and 300 px + 1fr grid scroll sideways on a phone and at 200% zoom
evidence: styles.css:2 fixes the width, styles.css:7 fixes a 300 px column, and there is no media query in styles.css.
failing_case: At 390 px width the page needs about 3x horizontal scrolling; at 200% zoom on a 1360 px screen the layout overflows (WCAG 1.4.10 reflow).
remediation: Use max-width: 1200px with width: 100%, and stack the grid to one column under about 700 px.

quote: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, your notes, supercharged.
title: Placeholder Lorem ipsum text ships in the visible page header
evidence: index.html:11 renders Lorem ipsum to every visitor under a 'Welcome to NoteMaster' heading.
failing_case: The first thing a user reads is Latin filler.
remediation: Replace with a specific one-line description of the app, or remove the hero so the notes list is the first thing on screen.

quote: const note = { id: Date.now(), title: 'Untitled', body: '', updated: Date.now() };
title: Date.now() ids collide, and delete then removes every note sharing the id
evidence: store.js:7 uses Date.now() as the id. deleteNote filters by id (store.js:30), openNote uses find by id (app.js:17).
failing_case: Two creates inside one millisecond (double-click, a script, or two tabs writing the same store) produce the same id. Deleting one deletes both; opening either always opens the first.
remediation: Use crypto.randomUUID() (or a counter checked against existing ids) for ids.
